==Purpose==
This template imitates the Wikipedia top link template: [[Wikipedia:Template:For]].

==Usage==
<!-- Note: these rules were reverse-engineered from the code above.
Please correct any errors if you know what it *should* mean -->
This template should be placed under the [[:Template:Character|Character template]] when used on character pages.
;Syntax
'''<code><nowiki>{{For|OTHER TOPIC|PAGE1|PAGE2}}</nowiki></code>'''
;Output
{{For|OTHER TOPIC|PAGE1|PAGE2}}
;Parameters
*If only two parameters are given ('''OTHER TOPIC''' and '''PAGE1'''), the ''" and [[PAGE2]]"'' part is left out.
*If only one parameter is given ('''OTHER TOPIC'''), the current page, with ''" (disambiguation)"'' added, is used as a default for '''PAGE1'''.


==Examples==
*'''<code><nowiki>{{For|different meanings of For}}</nowiki></code>'''
{{For|different meanings of For}}
:Only the '''OTHER TOPIC''' parameter is used.
*'''<code><nowiki>{{For|Community Portal|Wotwiki:Community_Portal}}</nowiki></code>'''
{{For|Community Portal|Wotwiki:Community_Portal}}
:Often used form with only '''OTHER TOPIC''' and '''PAGE1'''.
*'''<code><nowiki>{{For|details on the Tower split|Elaida's White Tower|Rebel Aes Sedai}}</nowiki></code>'''
{{For|details on the Tower split|Elaida's White Tower|Rebel Aes Sedai}}
:Using '''PAGE2''' for a second link.
